name: El Nido
description: Limestone cliffs, turquoise lagoons and island-hopping routes make El Nido a classic Palawan escape.

name: Coron
description: A destination for clear lagoons, dramatic islands, wreck diving and mountain viewpoints.

name: Baguio
description: A cool-weather mountain city known for pine trees, cafés, art and scenic viewpoints.

name: Sagada
description: Quiet mountain landscapes, caves, rice terraces and sunrise viewpoints create an adventurous retreat.

name: Vigan
description: Walk through a heritage city where preserved architecture, crafts and local food meet.

name: Manila
description: A busy capital with historic districts, museums, modern malls, food spots and nightlife.

name: Cebu City
description: A central Visayas gateway combining urban attractions, heritage sites and access to nearby beaches.

name: Bohol
description: Discover the Chocolate Hills, rivers, wildlife and coastal scenery in one compact island trip.

name: Boracay
description: Known for its powdery beach, water activities, sunsets and lively resort atmosphere.

name: Siargao
description: An island destination with surf culture, palm-lined roads, lagoons and a relaxed community vibe.

name: Davao City
description: A major southern city with food, nature attractions and easy access to mountain adventures.

name: Camiguin
description: A volcanic island packed with waterfalls, springs, viewpoints and coastal scenery.

name: Iloilo City
description: A food and heritage destination famous for local dishes, riverfront walks and historic architecture.

name: La Union
description: A popular coastal escape combining surfing, cafés, sunsets and an easygoing weekend atmosphere.

name: Bukidnon
description: Highland landscapes, farms and wide-open views offer a slower alternative to crowded destinations.
